description: Update an existing payment (Holded API v2). IMPORTANT: Holded's PUT /payments/{id} REPLACES the record rather than merging, so any field omitted from the body is blanked. To prevent that, this tool first re-reads the current payment and merges your changes over it, preserving fields you did not pass (contactId, bankId, date, ...).

bankId.description: Bank account id to link the payment to

contactId.description: Contact id associated with the payment

date.description: Payment date as a Unix timestamp (seconds)

name: update_payment
